title: thePing
description: Sneak and Continuous Scrolling to Ping Locations.
body:
使用方式：
### 蹲下，看著目標並持續捲動滾輪

可標記位置，讓其他玩家能看到你所指的目標位置。
> p.s. 測距儀功能為粗估參考用。
----
How to use:
### Look, sneak and keep scrolling your wheel.
Mark locations in-game, allowing other players to see the position you are pointing at.
> p.s. The rangefinder feature is approximate.
